name: Cliach

attributes.attribute: unsuccessful suitor of a daughter of Bodb Derg
kept away by magic for more than a year

text: Cliach is a harper who seeks the hand of one of the daughters of Bodb Derg. The father refuses the match and calls on his magic to guard his door. His spell keeps the suitor away for more than a year, so the courtship fails. In Irish tale convention a harper's craft carries high standing. Music wins favor at the otherworld courts where such suits are made. Yet even that art cannot break the enchantment around the hall. Cliach gains neither entry nor the bride.

okr.objective: Cliach is the harper whose suit for Bodb Derg's daughter fails against the father's magic.
key_results: Show Cliach as a harper who woos a daughter of Bodb Derg.
Show the father using magic to hold the suitor from his door.
Show the courtship ending after more than a year of that keeping-away.
okr.evidence: MacKillop, Dictionary of Celtic Mythology, s.v. Cliach
